test_is_constant_source: test the is_constant_source function to check if a guard source is a constant source
test_is_input_source: test the is_input_source function to check if a guard source is a local or global input source
build_LocalSource: build a LocalSource instance to represent a local variable with a given name in torch dynamo guards
build_GlobalSource: build a GlobalSource instance to represent a global variable reference in torch dynamo guards
build_AttrSource: build an AttrSource instance to represent attribute access chaining on a base source in torch dynamo guards
